sources.title: Model Files and Wake Word Training | KoljaB/RealtimeSTT | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document covers custom wake word model usage, training, and the management of binary model files in RealtimeSTT. It explains the supported model file formats (TFLite and ONNX), the installation of specialized runtimes like Kroko-ONNX, and the warmup_audio.wav mechanism used to initialize the transcription engine.

sources.title: A New TinyML Streaming Benchmark for MLPerf Tiny v1.3
sources.snippet: To address these limitations, MLCommons introduces a new streaming benchmark in the current iteration (V1.3). A New Streaming Benchmark The streaming benchmark evaluates the real-time detection of a wake word, such as "Hey Siri" or "Alexa," in a noisy audio stream.
